headline: "Nurturing 500 global scale-ups"... four major strategies to expand SME exports
summary: South Korea's SME exports reached a record $64 billion in the first half of the year. The government unveiled four strategies to expand SME exports, including support for promising firms.
why: Export performance is a key indicator of South Korea's trade health, as the economy depends heavily on international sales. Small and medium enterprises form a large share of its business base.
